title: 【Bug】从 OpenRouter 获取模型列表时，报错 "values() must be called
body: ### 📦 Platform Vercel ### 📦 Deploymenet mode server db(lobe-chat-database image) ### 📌 Version v1.132.11 ### 💻 Operating System Windows ### 🌐 Browser Firefox ### 🐛 Bug Description 当我在设置中配置 OpenRouter 并尝试获取模型列表时，前端会提示 “Request failed”，同时后端服务会崩溃或报错。 错误日志 (Error Log): 我查看了部署应用的后端日志，发现了以下关键错误信息。这明確地指向了一个数据库操作问题，似乎是程序在尝试插入一个空的数据列表。 ``` 2025-09-25T14:38:47.419Z [info] {"level":30,"time":1758811127417,"pid":4,"hostname":"169.254.**.**","msg":"Error in tRPC handler (lambda) on path: aiModel.batchUpdateAiModels, type: mutation"} 2025-09-25T14:38:47.419Z [error] Error [TRPCError]: values() must be called with at least one value at PgInsertBuilder.values (.next/server/chunks/60629.js:4122:13) at AiModelModel.batchUpdateAiModels (.next/server/chunks/30140.js:556:83) at (.next/server/chunks/30140.js:6824:33) at resolveMiddleware (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1248:23) at callRecursive (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1283:24) at Object.next (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1289:12) at inputValidatorMiddleware (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1077:15) at async callRecursive (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1283:18) at async callRecursive (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1283:18) { code: 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR', [cause]: Error: values() must be called with at least one value at PgInsertBuilder.values (.next/server/chunks/60629.js:4122:13) at AiModelModel.batchUpdateAiModels (.next/server/chunks/30140.js:556:83) at (.next/server/chunks/30140.js:6824:33) at resolveMiddleware (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1248:23) at callRecursive (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1283:24) at Object.next (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1289:12) at inputValidatorMiddleware (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1077:15) at async callRecursive (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1283:18) at async callRecursive (.next/server/chunks/72581.js:1283:18) } ``` ### 📷 Recurrence Steps 复现步骤 (Steps to Reproduce): 1. 进入 设置 -> AI 服务商 页面。 2. 在服务商列表中选择 OpenRouter。 3. 填入有效的 OpenRouter API Key 和 API 代理地址 (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1)。 4. 点击【获取模型】按钮。 5. 此时，前端界面会立即弹出 “Request failed” 的错误提示。 ``` Request failed Sorry, the server seems to be experiencing some difficulties and is temporarily unable to complete your request. Please try again later. `values() must be called with at least one value` ``` ### 🚦 Expected Behavior _No response_ ### 📝 Additional Information 问题具有唯一性：我测试了其他 AI 服务商（例如 Azure OpenAI, Google AI 等），它们的模型列表都可以正常获取和保存。目前只有 OpenRouter 这一个服务商存在此问题。 • 环境信息：我的应用部署在 Vercel 平台，使用的数据库是 Vercel Postgres (NeonDB) 从日志来看，这个问题似乎不是 OpenRouter API 的问题，而是 LobeChat 后端在从 OpenRouter 获取到模型数据后，尝试将这些数据存入自己数据库时（调用 batchUpdateAiModels 函数）的逻辑缺陷导致的。可能是在某些情况下程序没有正确处理空的数据列表，直接将其传递给了数据库的插入操作，从而触发了错误。

linked_prs.title: 🐛 fix(database): prevent empty array insertion in aiModel batch operations
linked_prs.body:
- Fixes #9429

### Changes
- Add validation to `batchUpdateAiModels` to return early if models array is empty
- Add validation to `batchToggleAiModels` to return early if models array is empty
- Add validation to `updateModelsOrder` to return early if sortMap array is empty

### Root Cause
The error "values() must be called with at least one value" occurred when OpenRouter returned an empty model list, and the `batchUpdateAiModels` function attempted to insert an empty array into the database using Drizzle ORM, which doesn't allow empty `.values()` calls.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)

## Summary by Sourcery

Prevent database errors by validating input arrays and returning early when they are empty in AI model batch operations and ordering functions

Bug Fixes:
- Add early return in batchUpdateAiModels when the models array is empty
- Add early return in batchToggleAiModels when the models array is empty
- Add early return in updateModelsOrder when the sortMap array is empty

ai_judgment.response: **Yes**. This is an agent issue because it involves integration with an LLM provider (OpenRouter) and highlights a failure in handling model data retrieval and storage, which is a memory-related issue (memory content error) tied to agent system behavior.
